description: La Lice: an armed obstacle run. Forge a whole standard knight (the Joust's rules: armoury pieces, one sword in the right gauntlet, at most 30 kg), then run a 10 m lane in up to 64 frames: three pendulums to pass at the right moment, stepping stones across a ford, a low beam to duck under, four straw posts to cut and a bell to strike. Everything (positions, periods, phases) is in the brief. The mark has no easy ceiling (distance, posts, bell, time, minus blows and wet feet); the run stops at the first impossible move and the distance reached counts. Three passes, best one kept.
